note: Initial multi-event calibration search. Validation events are excluded from parameter selection.

numerical_stability.policy: Preserve observed hourly flow/rainfall series at their native 60-minute support while HEC-HMS integrates internally at 3 minutes. Reject Muskingum candidates without a stable subreach representation within the HEC-HMS limit.
numerical_stability.reason: Satisfies dt <= 0.29 * SCS lag at the minimum lag search bound and prevents unstable Muskingum routing from being compensated by calibration parameters.

rerun_reason: Repeat the fixed E22_SEP2023 + E24_NOV2023 calibration search after numerical-stability correction; do not change the event split.
